mapper.select: SELECT * FROM request_idempotency WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND idempotency_key=#{key}
mapper.update: UPDATE request_idempotency SET response_status=#{responseStatus},response_body=#{body} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND idempotency_key=#{key} AND response_status IS NULL

UPDATE request_idempotency SET response_status=NULL, response_body=NULL WHERE (tenant_id, idempotency_key) IN ( SELECT tenant_id, idempotency_key FROM request_idempotency WHERE expires_at < #{now} AND response_body IS NOT NULL ORDER BY expires_at LIMIT #{limit})
